title: Relationship
description: A typed, effective-dated edge between two VNKC records (documents, procedures, organizations, jurisdictions).

from_id.description: Canonical ID of the subject record.

to_id.description: Canonical ID of the object record.

effective_date.description: When the relationship took/takes legal effect.

citation.description: Exact citation down to article/clause/point where the relationship is established, e.g. 'Điều 4, Luật 57/2024/QH15'.
